environment.description: Stream processor deployed on EKS cluster (us-east-1) in a private subnet. The Kafka consumer pod runs with default service account. No network policies applied to the namespace. Pod has unrestricted egress. The IMDS endpoint (169.254.169.254) is accessible from the pod. Kafka topic 'enrichment-events' accepts messages from any authenticated producer with write ACL.

config.network: No NetworkPolicy resources, default allow-all egress
config.imds: IMDSv1 enabled on node group (HttpTokens: optional)
config.kafka_acl: Producer ACL granted to 'partner-ingest' service account
config.iam_role: Pod IAM role arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/enrichment-processor has s3:*, secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
